_README: Curated registry of the LATEST labour-force period each National Statistical Office (NSO) has PUBLISHED. The pipeline compares this against ILOSTAT's latest period and lists everything in between as 'pending in ILOSTAT'. Only countries listed here get a pending badge; everything else shows 'not tracked'. Keys are ISO3 codes.

_schema.nso: Name/abbrev of the statistics office (shown in the UI)
_schema.nso_latest: Latest period the NSO has published: 'YYYY' | 'YYYYQn' | 'YYYYMmm'
_schema.periodicity: 'M' | 'Q' | 'A' — cadence used to enumerate the pending periods
_schema.source: URL to the NSO release / release calendar (shown as a link)
_schema.checked: YYYY-MM-DD this entry was last verified against the NSO site
_schema.note: free text (survey name, cadence quirks, caveats)

_policy: Every entry below was verified against an official NSO page. Countries whose correct value is uncertain are NOT listed here — they sit in _parked until resolved, because a wrong pending badge is worse than no badge.

IND.reason: PLFS moved from quarterly bulletins to a monthly bulletin series during 2025. The June 2026 monthly bulletin was confirmed on PIB, but the July 2026 press note could not be reached on an official domain — only secondary press. Need to confirm the monthly series is the right basis before tracking.

MEX.reason: INEGI runs two parallel tracks: monthly Indicadores de Ocupación y Empleo (latest June 2026) and the quarterly ENOE (latest 2026Q1). Which one ILOSTAT ingests determines the correct basis; picking the wrong one misstates the gap.

IDN.reason: Sakernas has February and August reference months (semi-annual). The registry schema only supports M/Q/A, and encoding it as monthly would enumerate every month in between and badly overstate the pending count. Needs schema support for a semi-annual cadence.

BHR.reason: The only current Bahraini source is the LMRA quarterly 'Labour Market Indicators', which is ADMINISTRATIVE work-permit data, not a household labour force survey. Wrong source family for the LFS index — it belongs to the Admin index if anywhere. The iGA household unemployment dataset on data.gov.bh is JS-rendered and robots-blocked, so no LFS period could be established.

KWT.reason: Latest LFS round appears to be 2016/2017, but the CSB page shows only publication listings (title, year, download count) rather than figures, and the LMIS portal could not be fetched. Confidence medium, not high.

ALB.reason: No Albanian observations present in Eurostat lfsi_emp_q (value object empty across the last 20 quarters). Needs a direct INSTAT check.

MNE.reason: No Montenegrin observations present in Eurostat lfsi_emp_q (value object empty across the last 20 quarters). Needs a direct MONSTAT check.
